content.title: Estimated amounts of radiation absorbed in procedures used to diagnose pulmonary embolism
content.summary: Table of absorbed radiation dose expressed in mGy for single organs or the foetus from diagnostic procedures used to diagnose pulmonary embolism. Effective doses in mSv are referenced elsewhere.
content.notes: Values appear as ranges and include separate entries for some procedures (eg, low and high administered activities for perfusion scans). Values derived from table on page (references cited on page).

table.Test: Perfusion lung scan with technetium-99m-labelled albumin

subentries.label: Low dose (≈440 MBq shown on page)
High dose (≈200 MBq shown on page)

content.source_text_snippet: In this section, absorbed radiation dose is expressed in mGy to reflect the radiation exposure to single organs, or the foetus, as a result of various diagnostic techniques. Estimated amounts of radiation absorbed in procedures used to diagnose pulmonary embolism (based on various references).
